cards.front: Recall a key point about Computer Systems and Architecture
cards.back: CPU: ALU (arithmetic/logic), CU (control signals), Registers: PC (next instruction), ACC (results), MAR (address), MDR (data), CIR (instruction), SR (flags)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Computer Systems and Architecture
cards.back: FDE: Fetch (PC to MAR, memory to MDR/CIR, PC++), Decode (CU interprets CIR), Execute (ALU/control)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Computer Systems and Architecture
cards.back: Pipelining: fetch/decode/execute overlap; hazards (data, control, structural)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Computer Systems and Architecture
cards.back: Memory: Registers > L1 cache > L2 > L3 > RAM > SSD > HDD; Virtual memory: paging, page table, TLB, page fault

cards.front: Recall a key point about Computer Systems and Architecture
cards.back: CISC: complex instructions, variable length, microcode; RISC: simple, fixed length, load/store, more registers

cards.front: Recall a key point about Computer Systems and Architecture
cards.back: Parallel: SIMD (single instruction, multiple data), MIMD (multicore); Amdahl: speedup = 1/((1-p) + p/n)
